props.name: value
props.meaning: The stored string. Two-way in Svelte.

props.name: on_value_change
props.meaning: Called on every change.

props.name: field
props.meaning: Supplies the valid values, the labels and the hidden values.

props.name: project_id
props.meaning: Given, the field's hidden values are removed from the list.

props.name: options
props.meaning: The set on offer, of the caller's own making. Wins over the field.

props.name: show_code
props.meaning: Draws the stored string as a row's right-aligned secondary, where it says more than the label.

props.name: secondary
props.meaning: A row's right-aligned value, of the caller's own making.

props.name: sub_label
props.meaning: The muted line under a row's label.

props.name: load_error
props.meaning: What a caller's read failed with, drawn in place of the list.

props.name: slot
props.meaning: The `data-slot` prefix every part of this picker carries.

props.name: picker
props.meaning: The `data-picker` the popup carries.

props.name: searchable
props.meaning: Offers a search box, which narrows the set in the browser.

props.name: size
props.meaning: Control height: 7, 8 and 9.

props.name: disabled
props.meaning: Greys the control and takes it out of the tab order.

props.name: readonly
props.meaning: Keeps full contrast and drops the chevron, the popup and the clear control.

props.name: invalid
props.meaning: Sets `aria-invalid` and the destructive ring.

props.name: clearable
props.meaning: Offers a control that clears the value. Unset, it follows the field: a mandatory one is never clearable.

props.name: placeholder
props.meaning: Shown while the field is unset.

props.name: search_placeholder
props.meaning: Placeholder of the search box.

props.name: open
props.meaning: Whether the popup is showing. Two-way in Svelte.

props.name: loading
props.meaning: A caller's read is in flight: skeletons, and the control is inert.

props.name: error
props.meaning: A message from the caller, drawn under the control.

props.name: empty_label
props.meaning: Shown when the list offers nothing.

props.name: loading_label
props.meaning: Names the skeletons a read stands behind, for a screen reader.

props.name: error_label
props.meaning: Shown in place of what the failed read said.

slots.name: mark
slots.draws: A row's leading mark. Given, every row carries one.

slots.name: valueChip
slots.draws: The control's value, in place of plain text.

keyboard.does: Narrows the list, where the picker is searchable
Chooses the highlighted row and closes
In an empty search box, clears the value
Closes the list and keeps the value
Leaves the control, or reaches the clear control when there is one
Moves the highlight, and the list scrolls it into view.
Takes the highlighted row. A multi picker keeps the popup open.
Closes the popup and clears the query. On a closed picker it does nothing.
In an empty query: takes the caret to the last chip of a multi picker; clears a single one.
On a chip, walks the row. `ArrowRight` past the last chip returns to the input.
On a chip, removes it and leaves the caret on its neighbour.
